acceptanceCriteria: Fixture flow with 8 sections: `section: "B"` returns only B's paragraphs; payload <= 1/4 of the unfiltered call.
Unknown section name -> typed `none-found` listing available section names.
No arguments -> identical output to today.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1247 (filed 2026-10-19 against build main-fa8afe6). `corvint.docs_flow` returns, for one flow id, the flow subject plus every claim, every relation on the flow, every joined test-knowledge record, and every paragraph of every section. There is no argument to request one section (e.g. only "Business rules") or only certain record kinds, so callers that need one section receive the whole flow. On a medium corpus, five sampled `docs_flow` calls returned ~19x the characters of a reference server answering the same flow-detail calls, which costs agent context and latency.
title: docs_flow: section and record-kind filters to bound the payload (GitHub #1247)
